name: Critical Care Registered Nurse (adult, pediatric, neonatal)
elig: Unencumbered RN/APRN license plus a minimum of recent direct-care hours with acutely or critically ill patients.

name: Progressive Care Certified Nurse
elig: RN license plus recent direct-care hours with acutely ill adults in progressive care.

name: Certified Emergency Nurse
elig: Current RN license; emergency experience is recommended but not mandatory.

name: Trauma Certified Registered Nurse
elig: Current RN license; trauma experience recommended.

name: Certified Pediatric Emergency Nurse
elig: Current RN license; pediatric emergency experience recommended.

name: Certified Flight Registered Nurse
elig: Current RN license; transport experience recommended.

name: Certified Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse
elig: RN license plus a minimum period and hours of med-surg practice set by MSNCB.

name: Oncology Certified Nurse
elig: RN license with required RN experience and oncology nursing practice hours.

name: Certified Pediatric Nurse
elig: RN license plus pediatric clinical hours within a set time frame.

name: Inpatient Obstetric Nursing
elig: RN license with specialty experience in inpatient obstetrics.

name: Neonatal Intensive Care Nursing
elig: RN license with NICU specialty experience.

name: Certified Perioperative Nurse
elig: RN license with perioperative experience.

name: Certified Wound, Ostomy, Continence Nurse
elig: RN with a bachelor’s degree and an accredited WOC program or experiential pathway.

name: Certified Hospice and Palliative Nurse
elig: RN license with hospice and palliative practice hours.

name: Psychiatric-Mental Health Nursing
elig: RN license, practice time as an RN, psychiatric-mental health hours and continuing education.

name: Gerontological Nursing
elig: RN license with gerontological practice hours and continuing education.

name: Nurse Executive
elig: RN with a bachelor’s degree or higher and mid-level or higher administrative experience.

name: Informatics Nursing
elig: RN with a bachelor’s degree, practice time and informatics experience or education.

name: Certified Case Manager
elig: Licensed health professional with qualifying case-management employment.

name: Certified Rehabilitation Registered Nurse
elig: RN license with rehabilitation nursing practice.

name: Family Nurse Practitioner — Board Certified
elig: RN license plus graduation from an accredited FNP graduate program.

name: Family Nurse Practitioner — Certified
elig: RN license plus graduation from an accredited FNP program.

name: Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
elig: RN license plus an accredited PMHNP graduate or post-graduate program.

name: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care NP
elig: RN license plus an accredited AGACNP program.

name: Certified Nurse-Midwife
elig: Graduation from an ACME-accredited midwifery program and an RN license.

name: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
elig: Graduation from an accredited nurse anesthesia program (doctoral entry) and passing the NCE.

name: Critical Care Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus specialty practice hours set by CNA.

name: Emergency Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus emergency practice hours.

name: Medical-Surgical Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus med-surg practice hours.

name: Gerontological Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus gerontological practice hours.

name: Oncology Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus oncology practice hours.

name: Psychiatric and Mental Health Nursing (Canada)
elig: Active Canadian RN registration plus mental-health practice hours.

name: Basic & Advanced Life Support
elig: Course completion; usually renewed every two years. Required by most employers.
